Dr Evans and the clinic was recommended to us by another vet when we found ourselves in a situation with a pup that needed some diagnostics and medication over the weekend. They have walk-in hours which was extremely convenient given our situation and I was pleased with their x ray pricing which seemed reasonable as well ($250 at the time of posting the review). Our other vet was not able to book us an appointment soon enough for what we needed and our situation did not warrant an emergency vet visit either. Vida vet clinic came in clutch! We'll probably be adding them to our main veterinary list moving forward!
They were very helpful and caring with our dog!
Best veterinary clinic in the valley I drive 45 minutes to get to them. They are fair, honest and superior to anybody else.
I’ve had such a good experience here with my dog! I would recommend to anyone who needs to take their pet in!
Awesome care for your furry family. Reasonable cost and very friendly. Thank you for making the appointment easy.

We recently moved from Seattle and needed a vet asap as our baby has red, irritated, goopy eye. They were very friendly, professional, and got us in same day. Truly appreciate the availability. Plus, they are transparent with pricing and explained what needed to be done in detail to evaluate our pup. Highly recommend!
I really like everything about this vet. I like how they take care of my fur babies. And the prices are very affordable. Thank you.

Great and awesome pet clinic. Helped bring my pitty up to date on vaccinations, got some supplement and food tips from the DR, and great advice for his bad hip. 10/10 recommend. Got me in very quickly too.

I had an excellent experience at Vida Veterinarian Clinic, and I felt compelled to leave a review because places like this truly deserve recognition.
First and foremost, I really appreciated that this clinic is privately owned and not a corporate veterinary office. Having come from using large corporate veterinarians in the past, the difference was immediately noticeable—in the best way. The pricing at Vida was very reasonable and significantly lower than what I’ve experienced elsewhere, without sacrificing quality of care at all.
The staff was incredibly helpful, friendly, and welcoming from the moment I walked in. Everyone took the time to explain things clearly, answer questions, and genuinely made me feel like my pet’s health actually mattered—not like I was being rushed through an assembly line. On top of that, they were extremely knowledgeable, which gave me a lot of confidence in the care my pet received.
It’s refreshing to find a veterinary clinic that combines fair pricing, expert care, and compassionate service. If you’re looking for a vet that feels personal, honest, and truly focused on your pet’s well-being, I highly recommend Vida Veterinarian Clinic. I’ll definitely be coming back.
